title: Jeremiah Threatened with Death

questions.question: At the beginning of the reign of which king did this word come from the Lord to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:1 (ESV): "In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from the Lord:"

questions.question: Where did the Lord tell Jeremiah to stand and speak all the words he had commanded him?
options: The court of the Lord's house
questions.correctAnswer: The court of the Lord's house
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:2 (ESV): "Stand in the court of the Lord's house, and speak to all the cities of Judah that come to worship..."

questions.question: "It may be they will listen, and every one turn from his evil way, that I may... of the disaster that I intend to do to them because of their evil deeds."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:3 (ESV): "that I may relent of the disaster that I intend to do to them because of their evil deeds."

questions.question: "If you will not listen to me, to walk in my... that I have set before you, and to listen to the words of my servants the prophets..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:4-5 (ESV): "If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law that I have set before you,"

questions.question: "...then I will make this house like..., and I will make this city a... for all the nations of the earth."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:6 (ESV): "then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city a curse for all the nations of the earth."

questions.question: After Jeremiah finished speaking, who laid hold of him, saying, "You shall die!"?
options: The priests and the prophets and all the people
questions.correctAnswer: The priests and the prophets and all the people
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:8 (ESV): "the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold of him, saying, 'You shall die!'"

questions.question: Where did the officials of Judah go when they heard these things, taking their seat at the New Gate?
options: From the king's house to the house of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: From the king's house to the house of the Lord
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:10 (ESV): "When the officials of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king's house to the house of the Lord and took their seat in the entry of the New Gate of the house of the Lord."

questions.question: What did the priests and the prophets say to the officials and all the people?
options: "This man deserves the sentence of death, because he has prophesied against this city,"
questions.correctAnswer: "This man deserves the sentence of death, because he has prophesied against this city,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:11 (ESV): "Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and to all the people, 'This man deserves the sentence of death, because he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears.'"

questions.question: Jeremiah told them: "Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring... blood upon yourselves and upon this city and its inhabitants, for in truth the Lord sent me to you..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:15 (ESV): "Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves and upon this city and its inhabitants,"

questions.question: What did the officials and all the people then say to the priests and prophets regarding Jeremiah?
options: "This man does not deserve the sentence of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
"We will lock him in the stocks."
questions.correctAnswer: "This man does not deserve the sentence of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:16 (ESV): "Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, 'This man does not deserve the sentence of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.'"

questions.question: Some of the elders of the land cited a prophet from the days of Hezekiah who also prophesied the destruction of Jerusalem. What was the name of this prophet?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:18 (ESV): "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and said to all the people of Judah:"

questions.question: Did King Hezekiah and all Judah put Micah to death when he prophesied that Zion would be plowed as a field?
options: No, he feared the Lord and entreated the favor of the Lord.
questions.correctAnswer: No, he feared the Lord and entreated the favor of the Lord.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:19 (ESV): "Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Did he not fear the Lord and entreat the favor of the Lord... ?"

questions.question: Another man who prophesied in the name of the Lord, similar to Jeremiah, was named Uriah. What did King Jehoiakim do to Uriah when he fled to Egypt?
options: He had him brought back and struck him down with the sword.
He let him live there in peace.
He made an alliance with Pharaoh against him.
questions.correctAnswer: He had him brought back and struck him down with the sword.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:22-23 (ESV): "and they fetched Uriah from Egypt and brought him to King Jehoiakim, who struck him down with the sword and cast his dead body into the burial place of the common people."

questions.question: Where was Uriah cast after he was killed by Jehoiakim?
options: The burial place of the common people
questions.correctAnswer: The burial place of the common people
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:23 (ESV): "who struck him down with the sword and cast his dead body into the burial place of the common people."

questions.question: Who was the son of Shaphan who protected Jeremiah so that he was not handed over to the people to be put to death?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 26:24 (ESV): "But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah so that he was not given over to the people to be put to death."

key_verse_text: "Now therefore mend your ways and your deeds, and obey the voice of the Lord your God, and the Lord will relent of the disaster that he has pronounced against you."
